categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the development and operation of online and mobile games, focusing on MMORPG and diverse gameplay types. It also engages in game licensing and IP cooperation for mobile games. The business includes self-developed game operations, overseas licensing, and service provision related to digital gaming.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced 3D MMORPG technology, including 3D imaging, real-time online battle systems, game production tools, player account management, virtual goods transaction technology, and social networking integration. It employs the Gamebryo 3D engine with proprietary development of various editors and tools to enhance game production efficiency and quality. AI assistants and AI-based multilingual translation tools are also integrated to improve service and player experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global online and mobile game players, with significant markets in Japan, Taiwan, China, Southeast Asia, Europe, and the Americas. The company targets both casual and hardcore gamers through free-to-play models with virtual item sales. It serves game operators and end-users via direct operation and licensing agreements.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in Taiwan, Japan, China, Southeast Asia, Europe, and the United States. It maintains overseas subsidiaries and partners to support localized operations and marketing, emphasizing expansion in mature and emerging markets worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the gaming industry supply chain, focusing on game development (upstream) and direct game operation and licensing (midstream). It develops proprietary games and manages their distribution and monetization, including virtual goods sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in game development with diversified game types and international IP expansion. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on next-generation 3D engine development, rapid content updates, AI-enhanced customer service, and cross-industry collaborations. It aims to strengthen global market penetration and enhance player community engagement.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of virtual game points and in-game items, licensing fees from overseas partners, and service income related to game operations. The company employs a free-to-play model with monetization via virtual goods and premium content, supplemented by royalties from licensed IP.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic and international game developers and operators, particularly those from Korea and China. It differentiates itself through proprietary high-quality MMORPG titles, strong R&D capabilities, and established overseas operations. It holds a notable market share in Taiwan and maintains competitive positioning in global markets through continuous innovation and service quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported revenues of approximately NT$1.58 billion with a net profit of NT$317.6 million, showing over 100% growth in net profit compared to the prior year. The company maintains a stable financial structure with increasing profitability and invests nearly 40% of operating expenses in R&D, reflecting a growth-oriented profile with strong operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, self-developed MMORPG games with rich 3D graphics and engaging gameplay. It offers continuous content updates and strong community features to enhance player retention. Its competitive edge lies in proprietary technology, diversified game portfolios, global market reach, and superior customer service supported by AI tools, creating a trusted and innovative gaming brand.
